group_position: middle shot of grp008 — Alice has left the entry tunnel and is on the first part of the entry_tunnel -> shaft_centre line, still high in the shaft.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: dropping clear of the tunnel mouth into the shaft, coming upright as the fall slows
characters.space_fragment_en: standing upright in mid-air just below the entry tunnel mouth, centred in frame, face turned up to the shrinking opening
characters.facing: body upright and square, head tipped back to the closing circle of light above her

path.to: out into the open centre of the shaft as the round walls open into the first pass

beats.action: the fall slows to nothing like a fall; her skirts and pinafore billow, her hair pulls up
beats.sync: the rule of the scene is established

beats.action: the glazed cupboards and rows of stoneware jars begin to slide up past her

performance_beat.objective: work out what is happening to her before deciding whether to be frightened
performance_beat.goal: work out what is happening before deciding to be frightened
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from the shock of a drop to an almost administrative acceptance that this fall is going to take a while

trigger.beat: the fall slows and stops feeling like falling

performance_beat.end_state: upright in the air, chin still raised to the opening above, arms loose, hair standing straight up
